title: Packers "owners" have an absolute right to boo

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Packers "owners" have an absolute right to boo
sources.description: While plenty of sports fans mistakenly believe that the purchase of a ticket to a game provides a license to engage in a wide range of antisocial behaviors, the customers of a given home team always have the prerogative to express displeasure with the performances they're witnessing.
